scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @health-intelligence/contracts && npm run build --workspace @health-intelligence/desktop
scripts.format: npm run format --workspaces --if-present && cargo fmt --all && ".venv\Scripts\python.exe" -m black services/clinical-worker
scripts.format:check: npm run format:check --workspaces --if-present && cargo fmt --all -- --check && ".venv\Scripts\python.exe" -m black --check services/clinical-worker
scripts.lint: npm run lint --workspaces --if-present && cargo clippy -p clinical-core --all-targets -- -D warnings
scripts.test: npm run test:contracts && npm run test:ui && npm run test:rust && npm run test:python && npm run fixtures:check
scripts.verify: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
